scripts.prezip: npm install && npm run build && composer install --no-dev && npm run docs-compliance
scripts.zip: zip -r studip-checkin-v$npm_package_version.zip controllers dist docs lib migrations vendor views LICENSE LICENSE-SUPPLEMENT.txt README.md StudipCheckin.php bootstrap.php plugin.manifest -x '*.editorconfig' -x 'vendor/*.git*' -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.docs-compliance: mkdir -p docs/compliance && npm sbom --sbom-format spdx --json > docs/compliance/npm-sbom.json && (npm audit --json > docs/compliance/npm-audit.json || true) && (composer audit --format=json > docs/compliance/composer-audit.json || true) && (composer licenses --format=json > docs/compliance/composer-licenses.json || true)
